reader_notes: The researcher here is 'the glass chemist Ottilie Brandt'; a historian with the identical name (Ottilie Brandt) leads the study in elf-b5-002 of the same batch. Within this unit it is harmless, but a student meeting both units in one session would notice the same person doing two unrelated jobs.

Q4 distractor D ('sorted by color beforehand') is close enough to the passage wording ('sorted by color and picked clean of everything but glass') that a hasty reader could take colour sorting, rather than the removal of non-glass, as the reason clean cullet tolerates a high share. The passage does support the distinction, but only by careful reading.
